name: repo-hygiene
description: Makes Claude audit a Git repository and its hosting provider like a senior Git expert: a routine skill that inspects every area without waiting to be told which commands to run, a user-invoked deep skill for forensics and multi-session cleanup programs (plan, restore-tested backup, review-thread adjudication, certificate), three read-only agents for large volumes, and a bundled Git reference with the official URL on every entry. It reads freely and changes nothing without the user's approval of each item.
